verdict.rationale: GrowthBook ships an official MCP server that loads 'Agent Skills' (workflows and guardrails) and exposes the REST API to AI tools like Cursor, VS Code, and Claude, letting an AI-native user manage feature flags/experiments via natural-language commands through those connected agents. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence confirming this works reliably in practice, and more detail on the range of natural-language operations supported beyond the docs' description.
